_comment: W1.8 (NPDEV_ROADMAP_2026-09-12.md). Ratchet floor per browser routine, read/written by scripts/quality/check-a11y-baseline.py from scripts/quality/run-shell-scenarios.ps1's own shell-scenarios-report.json. Counts are axe-core violation NODE counts (not rule counts) per impact level, scoped to the wcag2a/wcag2aa/wcag21aa/best-practice tag families -- see NPDevSamples/scripts/browser/vendor/axe-core/VERSION.json for the pinned engine version. A routine with no entry yet gets one from its first real measurement rather than blocking a merge. A DROP for a routine that produced a fresh scan this run auto-ratchets the floor down; an INCREASE is a gate failure unless --write-baseline is passed explicitly. Never hand-edit a count downward to fake progress -- let the ratchet script do it from a real scan.
